analysis: Both changed files are documentation only (docs/architecture/hardware-support.md, docs/architecture/inference.md). No source, wire protocol, key custody, attestation or cache-storage behaviour changes in this PR. Documented content describes existing/provider-local behaviour: GLM5Next native serving boundary (fail-closed retention of owners on unproven retirement/wired-residency faults, quarantine of GLM work only, /metrics reports retained-fault state), memory-admission ledger (ProcessMemoryLedger, EngineProcessMemoryOwner), MiMo tool-schema restoration (MiMoV26ToolEvidence rejects client-supplied reserved schema metadata, grants no tool/media/memory bypass), GLM tool-suffix validation (1 MiB cap, malformed suffix fails before any parsed call is published), and a redacted bridge-shutdown diagnostic (error payload not logged). Relevant threats considered: T-007/T-056 (docs state tests do not establish output parity or runtime secrecy), T-010/T-029 (availability/memory retention), T-041 (media requests excluded from prefix lookup/capture, so no KV is reused across images; consistent with the cache-scope mitigations, SSD tier unchanged). Cross-repo links point to immutable darkbloom-platform commit 48a198c; no new endpoint or deployment claim. No contradictions with the threat model were found, and no threat-model update is needed from these doc edits. Coverage limit: the described code behaviours (memory ledger, GLM/MiMo paths) are not in this diff, so the claims are unverified here; the next pass should only validate if source changes accompany them.
